QUOTE: "`auto_ok = loop_config_.auto_approve_tools || server_manager_.is_explicitly_allowed(name, args)`" and "The allow list only skips the prompt. The deny list is checked after approval"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips the prompt and shows it is consulted in `check_approval` (`tool_executor.cpp`). The deny list is enforced in a different file (`server_manager.cpp`), which covers the substance of the item.
